221171.Description:
Both sets contain 10 new cards all in foil version (5 types x 2 cards each) that will power up cards from UW1 & UW2!
Contents:
• 3 packs
•10 new foil cards
•1 official DBSCG die

227393.Description:
[Unique] [Blocker]
[Union-Fusion] Draw 1 card : Red "Son Goku : Br" and red "Vegeta : Br".
[Activate:Main] RRR: If your Leader Card is a red "Gogeta : Br" card and you have 4 or more energy : Choose up to 1 mono-red "Gogeta : Br" card with an energy cost of 8 or less from your deck or hand, play it on top of this card, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it. You can't activate the [Activate:Main] skill on copies of this card for the turn.

227394.Description:
[Blocker]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is a blue "Vegeta : GT" card and you have 4 or more mono-blue energy : When this card is played, draw 1 card, then if you don't have a Unison Card in play, play up to 1 {SS4 Son Goku, Protector of the Earth} from your deck or hand with 3 markers on it, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it.
[Auto] [Once per turn] If you have a blue Unison Card in play with 2 or more markers on it : At the end of your turn, switch this card to Active Mode.

227395.Description: [Auto] When this card is played, add up to 1 green "Majin" card with an energy cost of 7 or less from your deck to your hand, then shuffle your deck.

227396.Description:
[Unique] [Indestructible]
[Auto] Y, if your Leader Card is a yellow "Demon Clan" card, and it's your turn : When one of your yellow "Demon Clan" cards is removed from your Battle Area by a skill, play this card from your hand.
[Auto] [Once per turn] Switch this card to Rest Mode : When you activate an [Overlord] skill, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards in Rest Mode and KO it.

227397.Description:
[Permanent] This card can't attack if it has 2 or fewer markers on it.
[+1] [Activate:Main] You may choose 1 card in your hand and send it to your Warp. If you do, draw 1 card.
[-2] [Activate:Battle] For each card in your Warp, this card gets +5000 power for the battle.
